title: Each agent worktree gets its own branch, and no worktree is pruned mid-task
why: Agents in a lane are not blocked or lose work through a shared branch or a pruned worktree.
note: Coordinator 22:21 CST Nov 6, from lane qmax-browser-main-red: 3 agents were blocked because two worktrees held one local branch, and 2 agent worktrees were pruned mid-task (cause unknown). Find the cause first: who names the branch, and what prunes a live worktree.
